## In the app the game's own balance is shown as "coins".
##
## The balance is an in-game number the player earns and spends by playing. On the website it is
## named after the $CHIKI token, because there it can be collected on-chain; in the app nothing is
## collected anywhere, so the name would be the only thing left presenting a cryptocurrency. Rather
## than rewrite several hundred call sites, every Label, Button and RichTextLabel already passes its
## text through TranslationServer (the game does not use it for anything else), so one translation
## renames the currency everywhere it is drawn. Installed only when `crypto` is off: the website
## never sees it.
static var _words: Translation = null


static func install_app_words() -> void:
	if _words != null or on("crypto"):
		return
	_words = AppWords.new()
	_words.locale = TranslationServer.get_locale()
	TranslationServer.add_translation(_words)


## Must run before the engine shuts down: a script-backed Translation still registered when its
## script is freed crashes the engine on exit.
static func remove_app_words() -> void:
	if _words != null:
		TranslationServer.remove_translation(_words)
		_words = null


class AppWords extends Translation:
	func _get_message(src_message: StringName, context: StringName = &"") -> StringName:
		var s: = String(src_message)
		if s.find("$CHIKI") < 0:
			return &""
		return StringName(s.replace("REAL $CHIKI", "COINS").replace("real $CHIKI", "coins").replace("$CHIKI", "coins"))
